items.issue: Natural-durability classifications commonly concern heartwood, while sapwood may have different durability and treatment behaviour. A board can include both zones.
items.next_action: Allow material-zone metadata on the actual member and do not assign whole-piece durability solely from a species name.

items.preferred_term: wood-plastic composite decking as a manufacturer-defined product
items.issue: WPC decking mixes polymer and wood-derived material and uses product-specific sections, spans, clips, gaps and thermal movement. It is not automatically structural timber or interchangeable with a solid wood board.
items.next_action: Require the selected product profile and manufacturer installation data before generating supports, clips or expansion gaps.

items.preferred_term: side gap, butt gap and perimeter gap
items.issue: The long-edge drainage gap, end-to-end movement joint and clearance at walls or obstructions have different directions, functions and setting rules.
items.next_action: Store each gap type and its governing product, moisture, drainage and movement conditions separately.

items.preferred_term: breaker board and picture-frame border
items.issue: A breaker board interrupts field-board length or direction and can receive butt ends. A picture-frame border follows the perimeter. Both are visual features but need different supporting framing and joints.
items.next_action: Choose route geometry first and generate the dedicated support and fixing pattern for that route.

items.preferred_term: face fixing and concealed clip fixing
items.issue: A face screw or nail passes through the exposed board. A concealed clip engages side grooves or an underside feature and commonly requires a system screw, starting clip and product-specific spacing.
items.next_action: Resolve the board profile and fixing system before placing holes, clips or support lines.

items.preferred_term: external above-ground waterproofing membrane
items.issue: External balconies and roof terraces are exposed to weather, thermal movement and exterior drainage conditions and use the AS 4654 pathway where applicable. Internal wet areas use a different NCC and AS 3740 pathway.
items.next_action: Use location and exposure to select the regulatory object family; do not reuse the internal wet-area generator outdoors.

items.preferred_term: structural substrate, fall-forming layer, membrane and finish as separate layers
items.issue: A balcony floor description can hide four different objects with different roles. Falls may be in the structure or a screed, the membrane controls water, and tile or pavers provide the traffic finish.
items.next_action: Generate an ordered layer stack and record which layer creates the drainage falls.

items.preferred_term: liquid-applied and sheet-applied external membranes
items.issue: Liquid systems cure into a field with wet-film and reinforcement details; sheet systems use manufactured thickness, laps, seams and adhesives or heat welding. Their corners, joints and repairs differ.
items.next_action: Require membrane family and selected product before generating laps, reinforcement or thickness metadata.

items.preferred_term: bond breaker, backing rod and release tape as distinct joint parts
items.issue: Backing rod sets joint depth and supports sealant, release tape prevents adhesion to a third face, and a broader bond-breaker detail can use either form depending on geometry and system.
items.next_action: Store joint geometry, adhesion faces and selected bond-breaker form instead of collapsing every detail to tape.

items.preferred_term: formed corner fillet and sealant fillet
items.issue: A formed fillet changes a sharp substrate corner into a radius or splay; a sealant fillet is a compatible bead used in a selected membrane junction detail. Their material and movement behaviour differ.
items.next_action: Store fillet material, shape and intended movement function before drawing the corner.

items.preferred_term: membrane upturn and membrane downturn
items.issue: An upturn rises at a wall, sill, hob or penetration to terminate above the drained field. A downturn wraps over a free edge to shed water. The generic word return does not identify water direction.
items.next_action: Resolve edge type and drainage direction before generating vertical membrane geometry.

items.preferred_term: waterstop angle, termination bar and overflashing as separate termination parts
items.issue: A waterstop forms a retained edge, a termination bar mechanically secures a membrane edge, and an overflashing sheds weather over the termination. Similar linear profiles do not make the roles interchangeable.
items.next_action: Model retained edge, mechanical fixing and weather shedding as independent roles.

items.preferred_term: door subsill flashing, threshold interface and threshold drain
items.issue: The door sill is part of the frame, a subsill flashing collects leakage below it, the threshold interface coordinates levels and membrane, and an optional channel drains surface water. One label cannot safely choose all parts.
items.next_action: Store internal, sill, external finish and drainage levels plus every water-control component.

items.preferred_term: point drain, linear drain and scupper
items.issue: A point drain collects into a local body, a linear drain collects along a channel, and a scupper passes water through an edge wall or hob. They need different openings, falls and membrane flanges.
items.next_action: Choose collection geometry and discharge direction before shaping falls or penetrations.

items.preferred_term: primary drainage and emergency overflow
items.issue: A primary outlet drains routine runoff. An overflow operates at a higher water level when primary drainage is restricted or exceeded and may need visible discharge. Two equal-looking openings can have different roles.
items.next_action: Store role, invert, capacity and discharge destination for each outlet.

items.preferred_term: terrace pedestal support
items.issue: Pod is informal and can also mean a waffle-slab void former. A terrace pedestal is a discrete support for pavers, rails or deck tiles and may be fixed-height or adjustable.
items.next_action: Use host and supported object to disambiguate terrace pedestal from slab pod.

items.preferred_term: fixed-height support and adjustable pedestal
items.issue: A fixed pad has a set thickness and limited shim adjustment; an adjustable pedestal uses a body, head and sometimes extenders or slope correctors. Their height ranges and stability details differ.
items.next_action: Select support family and verified height range before laying out support points.

items.preferred_term: tile and paver identified by product and support method
items.issue: Tile and paver overlap in everyday language. A thin bonded unit, thick self-supporting pedestal paver and dry-laid landscape paver use different structural checks, joints and supports.
items.next_action: Require product thickness, support condition and exterior evidence rather than resolving from the marketing name.

items.preferred_term: pedestal-supported porcelain paver and bonded porcelain tile
items.issue: A pedestal paver spans between discrete corner or rail supports. A bonded tile transfers load through adhesive and a continuous bed. Identical surface material does not establish the structural form.
items.next_action: Make support method a required discriminator before selecting panel thickness, joints and CAD support points.

items.preferred_term: modular deck tile and ceramic or stone tile
items.issue: A modular deck tile commonly has a timber or composite slatted face and backing designed for dry support. A ceramic or stone tile is a mineral finish installed by a bonded or pedestal method.
items.next_action: Resolve face material, backing and support system before interpreting deck tile.

items.preferred_term: membrane protection board and drainage cell
items.issue: A protection board resists damage to the membrane; a drainage cell deliberately maintains flow voids. Some composites may perform both only when product evidence says so.
items.next_action: Store protection and drainage as separate performance roles even if one product instance carries both.

items.preferred_term: raised-finish drainage cavity and framed subfloor space
items.issue: A shallow cavity between membrane and pedestal pavers drains and may contain services. A framed subfloor is the larger space beneath joists and can require ventilation, termite access and structural inspection.
items.next_action: Use bounding layers, support system and inspection requirements to classify the void.

items.preferred_term: planter membrane, root barrier, protection, drainage cell and filter fabric as separate layers
items.issue: A single word can conceal waterproofing, root resistance, physical protection, water conveyance and particle filtration. A selected product may combine roles, but the evidence must be explicit.
items.next_action: Generate an ordered planter layer stack and attach performance evidence to each role.

items.preferred_term: planter primary outlet and planter overflow
items.issue: The base outlet handles normal drainage. The higher overflow limits retained water if that outlet is blocked or exceeded. Irrigation fittings are a third system.
items.next_action: Record outlet role, invert and discharge path and keep irrigation objects separate.

items.preferred_term: structural balcony setdown and fall-forming screed
items.issue: The setdown lowers the supporting structure to make room for the build-up. The screed is a non-structural or separately designed layer shaping falls. Neither term alone defines the final threshold level.
items.next_action: Store structural levels, build-up thicknesses and the layer carrying falls independently.

items.preferred_term: balcony soffit lining and under-deck drainage tray
items.issue: A soffit is the visible enclosure. A drainage tray above or behind it catches water. Treating the lining itself as a drain can conceal leaks and omit fall, outlets and inspection access.
items.next_action: Model visible lining and water-conveyance plane separately with explicit access.

items.preferred_term: terrace parapet, waterproofing hob and safety barrier as separate roles
items.issue: A parapet or hob contains the membrane edge; a barrier resists people falling; a wall may enclose space and carry cladding. One physical assembly can combine roles only when each performance is designed.
items.next_action: Store edge containment, weathering and fall-protection roles independently.

items.preferred_term: H2D8 spaced-decking exception as a waterproofing-solution condition
items.candidate_term: open decks are exempt from the NCC
items.issue: The Volume Two H2D8 exception concerns the external waterproofing provision for spaced decking with framing suitable for external use. It does not remove structural, durability, drainage, termite, barrier or jurisdictional obligations.
items.next_action: Record the exact H2D8 exception conditions and continue evaluating every other applicable performance and construction requirement.

items.preferred_term: AS 4654.1 material suitability and AS 4654.2 design and installation
items.issue: The two parts cover different evidence: product materials in Part 1 and design and installation in Part 2. A product claim does not establish a compliant threshold, fall, drain, termination or installed system.
items.next_action: Store product and installation evidence separately, including edition, scope and selected detail.

items.preferred_term: under-deck drainage as secondary capture below open decking
items.issue: Under-deck trays catch water after it passes through the surface. They do not make the boards above a continuous membrane or automatically qualify the deck above internal space for the external waterproofing solution.
items.next_action: Keep the traffic surface, primary water-control plane and secondary capture plane as separate system attributes.

items.preferred_term: pedestal base, membrane protection pad and pedestal head pad
items.issue: The base spreads load, a protection pad separates it from the membrane, and a head pad cushions or grips the supported paver. A manufacturer may combine parts, but their locations and functions remain different.
items.next_action: Place each pad at its actual interface and allow combined product instances only when documented.
